## Test Build - ef6b804b92473680acbedb6865cad128c2a8f8d2

**This is an automated test build for testing purposes.**

Built from commit: [`ef6b804b92473680acbedb6865cad128c2a8f8d2`](https://github.com/bshuler/critical-orientation/commit/ef6b804b92473680acbedb6865cad128c2a8f8d2)

### Available JARs

Every jar the matrix produces is attached below; the list is
generated from the build rather than written out here, because a
hand-maintained table goes stale the moment a version is added.
(It had: it named four Minecraft versions long after the matrix
reached fifteen.) File names are
`critical-orientation-<mc>-<loader>-*.jar`.

| Minecraft | Loaders |
|-----------|---------|
| 26.2, 26.1.2, 26.1.1, 26.1 | Fabric, NeoForge |
| 1.21.11, 1.21.10, 1.21.9, 1.21.8 | Fabric, NeoForge |
| 1.21.7, 1.21.6, 1.21.5, 1.21.4 | Fabric, NeoForge |
| 1.20.1, 1.19.4, 1.18.2 | Fabric, Forge |

### Testing Instructions
1. Download the JAR for your Minecraft version and loader
2. Place in your `mods` folder
3. Launch Minecraft and test the `\` keybind
4. Report any issues!

---
*This release will be replaced on the next push to main.*
